outcome: Poor pregnancy outcome due to Gestational Alloimmune Liver Disease (GALD)
cohort: The study included 151 women with a history of affected offspring who received antenatal IVIG treatment, with their outcomes compared to untreated pregnancies.
finding: Antenatal therapy with high-dose IVIG, whether initiated at 14 or 18 gestational weeks, effectively prevents poor outcomes in pregnancies at risk for GALD.
